import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Hungary {
        static final int SIZE = 2000;
        int cnt;
        int[] pos = new int[SIZE];
        int[] rev = new int[SIZE];
        int[] v = new int[SIZE];

        int gao(int n, List<List<Integer>> e) {
            cnt = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
            Arrays.fill(rev, -1);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(v, 0);
                if (match(i, e)) cnt++;
            }
            return cnt;
        }

        private boolean match(int x, List<List<Integer>> e) {
            for (int i = 0; i < e.get(x).size(); i++) {
                int y = e.get(x).get(i);
                if (v[y] == 1) continue;
                v[y] = 1;
                if (rev[y] < 0 || match(rev[y], e)) {
                    pos[x] = y;
                    rev[y] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int[] mr = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] mc = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int[][] a = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] b = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] f = new int[12][12];
    static int m, t;
    static List<Integer>[] e = new List[2000];
    static List<Integer>[][] c = new List[12][12];

    static void floodfill(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(f[i], -1);
        qr.add(sr);
        qc.add(sc);
        f[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            sr = qr.poll();
            sc = qc.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tr = sr + mr[i];
                int tc = sc + mc[i];
                if (a[tr][tc] >= 0 && f[tr][tc] < 0) {
                    f[tr][tc] = f[sr][sc] + 1;
                    qr.add(tr);
                    qc.add(tc);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void setmark(int sr, int sc, int cnt) {
        int[][] v = new int[12][12];
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(v[i], -1);
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.add(sr);
        qc.add(sc);
        v[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            sr = qr.poll();
            sc = qc.poll();
            if (v[sr][sc] > Math.min(t, f[sr][sc])) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < c[sr][sc].size(); j++) {
                for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
                    e[m + i].add(c[sr][sc].get(j));
                }
            }
            if (v[sr][sc] == Math.min(t, f[sr][sc])) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tr = sr + mr[i];
                int tc = sc + mc[i];
                if (a[tr][tc] >= 0 && v[tr][tc] < 0) {
                    v[tr][tc] = v[sr][sc] + 1;
                    qr.add(tr);
                    qc.add(tc);
                }
            }
        }
        m += cnt;
    }

    static Hungary match = new Hungary();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(a[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(b[i], -1);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
            e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                c[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        int sr = 0, sc = 0, o = 0, m_val = 0;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    a[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sr = i;
                    sc = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        floodfill(sr, sc);
        
        br.readLine(); // skip empty line
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    b[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < b[i][j]; k++) {
                    c[i][j].add(o++);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (f[i][j] < 0) f[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] > 0) {
                    setmark(i, j, a[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(match.gao(m, e));
    }
}
